proposals.observation: 17 of 19 quiz sessions stalled at intro_load and never reached the next step. Only 2 reached email_shown and 0 completed. The intro screen is the sole bottleneck — the call-to-action or load behaviour at that step is not moving people forward.
proposals.proposal: Rewrite the intro screen headline and primary CTA button copy to make the value of starting immediately concrete and specific to the ICP. Replace vague aspirational framing with a direct, grounded promise that names the tension the quiz resolves — e.g. the gap between earning well and not building. Shorten any body copy above the CTA to two lines maximum.
proposals.current_text: Discover your money personality and start building a healthier relationship with money.
proposals.new_text: Find out the story beneath your money habits — and what to do about it. Takes 3 minutes.
proposals.impact: Reduces intro-load abandonment; unlocks the funnel

proposals.observation: The Daily Blog Post GitHub Actions workflow failed on 2026-05-05T10:14:26Z. A blog post was committed that same day (commit 0e22087) suggesting a manual workaround was used, but the automated pipeline is broken. If the failure recurs, the 6-post queue will stall silently.
proposals.proposal: Add an explicit error-output step to the Daily Blog Post workflow's job that echoes the failing step's exit code and any API response body to the run log. This makes the failure cause visible in the next run without touching the workflow trigger or schedule — a single diff to the existing job steps.
